name: Hongli Liu
research_statement: I study how linguistic knowledge is represented and processed during real-time language comprehension. I am particularly interested in the relationship between categorical linguistic representations and continuous semantic and probabilistic information, and in how experimental, neural, and computational approaches can be combined to investigate this relationship.
